words.definition: the condition of your body, if you are well or ill
words.example: Good food is important for your health.

words.definition: physical activity that keeps your body strong
words.example: I do exercise every morning.

words.definition: all the parts of a person, like arms and legs
words.example: Exercise is good for your body.

words.definition: to move very fast on your feet
words.example: I run in the park every day.

words.definition: to move by putting one foot in front of the other
words.example: We walk to school together.

words.definition: to move through water using your arms and legs
words.example: I swim in the pool on Saturday.

words.definition: a place with equipment for exercise
words.example: My brother goes to the gym after work.

words.definition: a game or activity where you use your body, like football
words.example: Football is my favorite sport.

words.definition: having a lot of power in your body
words.example: He is strong because he trains a lot.

words.definition: well, and not often sick
words.example: Fruit and vegetables are healthy food.

words.definition: not feeling well, ill
words.example: My sister is sick today.

words.definition: a person who helps sick people get better
words.example: The doctor checks my heart.

words.definition: something you take to feel better when you are sick
words.example: Take this medicine after lunch.

words.definition: to relax and stop working for a while
words.example: You should rest when you are tired.

words.definition: needing sleep or rest
words.example: I feel tired after a long run.

words.definition: the power to be active and do things
words.example: Fruit gives me energy in the morning.

words.definition: the part of your body that pumps blood
words.example: Exercise makes your heart strong.

words.definition: the food that a person usually eats
words.example: A healthy diet has many vegetables.

words.definition: a clear liquid that people drink
words.example: Drink water after exercise.

words.definition: strong and healthy, especially from exercise
words.example: Swimming keeps me fit.

text: Good health is very important to me, so I exercise every day. In the morning, I run in the park near my house. Running makes my heart strong and gives me energy for the whole day. On Tuesday and Thursday, I go to the gym with my friend, and on the weekend, we swim at the pool. I also like to walk to school instead of taking the bus. Sport is important for a healthy body. I try to eat a good diet with fruit and vegetables, and I drink a lot of water every day. Last month, I was sick and I felt very tired all the time. I went to see a doctor, and she gave me some medicine. She also told me to rest for a few days. Now I feel strong and fit again. I learned that rest is also important, not only exercise. Every night, I sleep eight hours so my body can rest. I try to be healthy every day because a healthy body helps me study and play well.
